Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`, which is llvm-mc's default alignment for
PowerPC code and data and not rsasm's; see mips.txt.

=== ha and l of a label in another section
	.text
	.p2align 2
	lis 3, msg@ha
	addi 3, 3, msg@l
	lwz 4, msg@l(3)
	stw 4, msg+4@l(3)
	blr
	.data
	.p2align 2
	.space 0x8010
msg:	.long 1, 2

=== h and ha differ where bit 15 is set @ 0x10007ff0
	.text
	.p2align 2
here:
	lis 3, there@h
	ori 3, 3, there@l
	lis 4, there@ha
	addi 4, 4, there@l
	blr
there:
	blr

=== ha of a label below 0x8000 of its page @ 0x1000fff0
	.text
	.p2align 2
	lis 3, next@ha
	addi 3, 3, next@l
	lis 4, next@h
next:
	blr

=== ha and l with an addend
	.text
	.p2align 2
	lis 3, table+0x10000@ha
	addi 3, 3, table+0x10000@l
	lis 4, table-8@ha
	addi 4, 4, table-8@l
	blr
	.data
	.p2align 2
table:	.long 0

=== branches into another section
	.text
	.p2align 2
entry:
	bl helper
	b helper
	beq helper
	.section .text.helper, "ax"
	.p2align 2
helper:
	b entry
	bdnz entry

=== absolute branches to labels @ 0x1000
	.text
	.p2align 2
entry:
	bla target
	ba target
	.section .text.helper, "ax"
	.p2align 2
target:
	blr
	.org 0x40

=== data across sections
	.text
	.p2align 2
entry:
	blr
	.data
	.p2align 2
	.long entry
	.long entry - .
